x-autoFill.description: The data schema requires hybrid=false whenever SCO is disabled — enforce it and lock the toggle so the relationship is visible.

elements.text: App colors, typography, and component roundness are managed as the tenant theme configuration object and applied across POS, SCO, and CFD.
Per-day opening hours (MO/TU/…/WORKDAYS/WEEKEND) are pattern-keyed in the data schema and cannot be rendered by JSON Forms — set them via the API. A renderable shape is proposed in HRP-727.
